name: Recall Recent Context
description: A follow-up turn starts from the cards the last turns already found.
purpose: Hands the next turn of a conversation the cards its last turns already found, so a short follow-up needs no restating.
approach: Stores each turn's selected cards under the work item's key and returns the relevant ones at the start of the next turn.
out_of_scope: Finding cards by meaning, and a follow-up that shares no words with the earlier turns it refers to.
milestones: 1. Every synthetic multi-turn follow-up case returns the right earlier cards, and no stale or cross-work-item card is returned.
knowledge: Cards are re-selected from scratch each turn under a short budget, so a follow-up paid full cost and a timeout left a turn with nothing. Scope tags fence one work item's records from another's, while untagged legacy records stay visible. A purely lexical gate misses a paraphrase that shares no word, which is a known limit.
measures_of_success: On synthetic multi-turn cases the right earlier cards come back for a follow-up, and no stale or cross-work-item card is ever returned. Standing conditions: Keep stale and cross-work-item cards from being returned. Spend no model call.
parameters: The file store takes a root directory and caps for turns, cards, preview length, record age and items per card, with separate larger caps for the global scope. Scope keys name a conversation, a work item or the global scope.
inputs: For record: scope keys, the selected cards and the user's text. For load: scope keys, then the current turn's text for filtering.
outputs: Recent card records merged across scopes, narrower scope winning, deduplicated by card id, then filtered by relevance, with optional item-usage hints and rendered blocks.
effects: Writes small per-scope files atomically. Both calls are best effort and never raise.
usage_notes: Record after each turn that selected cards and load at the start of the next. Always pass the work item's key so the fence applies, and treat the result as a warm fallback beside, not instead of, normal retrieval.

name: Guide Toward The Long-Term Goal
description: A reply points the person toward their quest's next step without nagging.
purpose: Keeps the person moving toward the end they are working for, without hijacking a simple question or nagging.
approach: The reply voice answers first. A directive about the long-term goal is added to it, saying when to add one short pointer, at which level, with the real milestone and reading, and when to leave it out; a grader checks both sides on labelled cases.
out_of_scope: Choosing the milestone or the metric (the quest and its intent hold them), creating or linking intents (only a person does), the representative's standing view (quest-intents holds it) and correcting a repeated mistake (guide-by-feedback does that).
milestones: 1. The two-sided metric has a case set and a recorded result for the floor, the current reply voice and the guided arm. 2. The guided arm beats the current reply voice on the two-sided value, with no invented figure and no more awkward restraint cases.
knowledge: Proposed 2026-10-29 from the 2026-10-27 accountability meeting transcript (spiritual_data_funding/human_context/meetings/transcripts/2026-10-27-accountability-meeting-1JByS08XMyrA7HJk5rVpRQaRJqG29wMyzUk9QfHMba8k.txt, 49:15 to 50:27) and the 2026-10-28 excerpt (hierarchy of intents, 24:44 to 25:50). The direction: the assistant should generally encourage the person to move forward on the long-term goal, thinking in ESOI terms, aware of the next target milestone and the current metric, at whatever intent level makes sense for the context, and the metric must also catch awkward use of it.
measures_of_success: Nudge cases right and restraint cases right rise together, per intent level. Standing conditions: Never invent a milestone, date or figure. Answer the request first. Add no model call before the reply.
parameters: The directive text, the word limit of the reply and the model tier.
inputs: The quest, its next milestone and metric reading, the intent hierarchy it sits under (or, for a representative, its assigned quests), the conversation so far, and the message.
outputs: The reply, with or without one short pointer.
effects: None beyond the reply text; no added call.
usage_notes: Selected: guided_v2 (the LONG_TERM_GUIDANCE section of REPLY_VOICE_SYSTEM). reply_voice is the reply voice before it, guided the first candidate directive, no_nudge the floor.
